objectives.description: Explain ordinary debt, lending, saving and household spending contrasts.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions15.1.1 economy and money;15.1.2 financial-market reference; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: Selected debt versus lending, borrower/lender direction, mortgage loan, financial interest, savings/wealth/shortage, planned budget, instalment versus immediate settlement, gain/loss and crisis. Earlier A2 income/bill/payment words are prerequisites. PCIC15.1.1/.2 B1 and B2 columns differ from some original B1 recommendations; money/object loan and budget/quote boundaries remain explicit. No stock-investment procedures.

objectives.description: Identify and describe an ordinary tax payment without giving tax advice.
objectives.rationale: The bounded B1 tax-payment reference reuses A2-S-048 impuesto via S044 plus earlier pagar; no new meaning is manufactured for a longer bill explanation. PCIC15.2 B1 supplies payment, while B2 income-return institutions/procedures receive the later boundary below.

objectives.description: Describe ordinary buying/selling flows, imports/exports and promotional messages.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions15.3.1 transactions;15.3.2 foreign trade;15.3.3 advertising; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: Purchase/sale acts, consumption/user, physical import/export direction and printed promotional formats are enumerated. A2-C-089/090 advertising messages/activity and H buying/discount/payment terms supply earlier relations. Digital export B1-W-197 differs from S032 trade. Marketing strategy/campaign operations are outside this ordinary description.

objectives.description: Describe what an organization produces, with which resources and in which broad sector.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions15.4.1 organizations/15.4.2 condition;15.5.1 industry/15.5.2 agriculture/15.5.3 fishing; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: Broad production/manufacturing, raw-input role, manual worker, agriculture/livestock/fishing/building and familiar fuel sources are selected; W company/job/science terms and T transport provide prerequisites. PCIC15.4.2 has B2 company condition: S025 crisis is a deliberate ordinary B1 extension. PCIC15.5.2 B1 is blank, so no quota is invented; ordinary rural seed/crop sequence is selected through20.3/20.6 instead of specialist production systems.

objectives.description: Describe community participation, shared needs and social conduct.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions17.1.1 community life;17.1.2 social conduct; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: Community/group/member/participation, support, shared life, consideration, tolerance, equality, progress and accepted commitment close the familiar participation/needs/conduct scenario. P politeness and W union/workplace organization are exact prerequisites. B1 participation versus planned B2 participation ciudadana and C/W commitment level conflict are explicit, not new domain meanings.

objectives.description: Explain a familiar public institution, election or collective decision.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions17.2.1 political institutions and government; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: State versus government/nation, named territorial divisions, representative body/chambers, broad nonmonarchical/monarchical and democracy/dictatorship contrasts, governing, elections/votes/candidates/representation and UE/ONU recognition are bounded. Earlier office holders and T diplomacy are prerequisites. Current leaders, actual country classifications, party-platform taxonomies and voting procedures are not asserted.

objectives.description: Describe ordinary rules, rights and reported public/legal events without legal advice.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions17.3 law and justice;17.1 rights/duties; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: Rights reuse A2-S-175 rather than law-study A2-W-067; law, constitution, duties, freedom, legal/illegal and basic non-graphic crime-report labels are selected. T already supplies reporting/theft/witness/victim roles. This closes ordinary reported-event understanding without pretending it delivers legal procedure, adjudication or advice.

objectives.description: Understand ordinary news accounts of conflict and peace without operational detail.
objectives.rationale: Disagreement/protest/public demonstration/peaceful contrast and a small recognition set of soldier/military/weapon/bomb/rank are selected. Earlier A2 army/war/peace remain prerequisites. Public protest is not equated with violence. Military rank captain differs explicitly from T vessel command; no need to import every weapon or rank to understand the bounded news scenario.

objectives.description: Describe volunteered beliefs, observances and roles neutrally.
objectives.rationale: Optional belief/nonbelief, observance/prayer, context-sensitive religious roles, service/title/scripture names and attributed afterlife concepts are selected. A1 affiliations/worship places and A2 celebrations/Church institution remain prerequisites. Fe B1 versus actual PCIC B2 remains explicit. All beliefs are attributed, no disclosure requirement, scripture corpus or endorsement.

objectives.description: Express a familiar belief or value and distinguish it from certainty or proof.
objectives.rationale: Firm/ordinary belief, mental content and deliberate reflection support familiar viewpoints while generic pensar/creer/knowledge are inherited with their unresolved A1/A2 parent levels. Philosophy discipline keeps the earlier B1 proposal despite PCIC19.2 B2; the actual B1 column is pensar only. Doctrine systems and scholarly argumentation are later, not disguised as required B1 seeds.

objectives.description: Identify familiar space/weather-world phenomena and distinguish astronomy from belief.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions20.1 universe and space; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: Universe, outer space, atmosphere layer, astronaut/rocket/orbiting satellite and cultural horoscope recognition are selected against earlier visible sky/world/planet nouns. Atmosphere layer is distinct from W pressure unit. Horoscope is cultural content, not scientific evidence. Detailed celestial taxonomy/mechanisms are not necessary to the selected ordinary recognition scenario.

objectives.description: Describe an area's location, terrain and population movement.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions20.2.1 physical/human/political geography;20.2.2 landscapes; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: Country/state/nation/province/autonomous community, hemisphere/poles, peninsular/ocean/forest landscape, population and origin/destination migration perspectives plus scope adjectives are enumerated. Earlier directions/terrain/regions and location functions are inherited. No live population, boundary or citizenship guarantees; no exhaustive place-name catalogue.

objectives.description: Describe changes or needs in urban and rural surroundings.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions20.3.1 urban/20.3.2 rural spaces; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: Physical path/narrow path/meadow and residential/historic centre/firefighter-base descriptions close the new built/rural-environment contrasts. A2-F-062 afueras, earlier neighbourhoods, police station and H dwellings/changes remain prerequisites. The field/crop part is linked to flora, not another duplicated place set.

objectives.description: Explain familiar weather changes and recognize severe-weather labels.
objectives.rationale: Severe storm/temperature episodes, recurring rainy/hot characterization, frost and expected forecast cover observed weather/change discussion. Seasons, ordinary weather events, sky changes and temperatures are already A1/A2; a B1 source example does not automatically relevel those senses. Weather forecasts/alerts or medical advice are not provided.

objectives.description: Describe a bounded set of animal groups, features and human-animal relations.
objectives.rationale: Broad mammal/bird/reptile grouping, five familiar wild-animal distinctions and species/risk-of-extinction recognition extend earlier pets/farm/insect sets. W living-thing/biology vocabulary provides the parent. No infinite species list, diagnostic zoology, danger identification or handling instruction is claimed.

objectives.description: Describe ordinary plant growth and cultivation beyond immediate identification.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions20.6 flora;20.3.2 rural cultivation; B1/B2
objectives.rationale: Soil versus floor, small food plot/crop/turf/fruit-producing tree, seed placement, harvested result/action and moisture-loss change provide an ordinary growth/cultivation sequence. A2 plant parts, planting/watering/flowering/growing are inherited; B1 sowing versus A2 broader plant-placement is explicit. Conservation-area recognition adds a place label, not a legal/access guarantee.

objectives.description: Explain familiar pollution, conservation and natural-disaster problems.
objectives.rationale: Earlier pollution/recycling/resource-saving states support new cause/action/result, contaminating-source versus affected-state, material-origin, climate/disaster events, preservation/care, shortage/exhaustion, source options and ozone-layer recognition. Resource broad-parent B1 versus baseline/W B2 is an explicit relevel proposal. Scientific explanation detail, climate modelling and actual environmental certification are outside this lexical inventory.

frameworkSections: 9 specific notions15/17/19/20 B1/B2 and C1/C2 comparison
objectives.rationale: Every exact earlier S later baseline/public planned reference is reconciled: same broad resource proposes B1 here; other public-issue/long-horizon meanings retain B2 with concrete earlier-introduction alternatives.
